field_or_scale_restrictions: Free commercial license terminates above USD 1,000,000 annual revenue and requires enterprise licensing for continued commercial use.
Use restrictions prohibit using Stability AI Materials or derivatives/outputs to create or improve another foundational generative AI model, excluding the licensed Models or their Derivative Works.
rights.rationale: The exact pinned repository carries the Stability AI Community License. It grants research/non-commercial and limited commercial rights but imposes a USD 1M annual-revenue threshold, downstream license obligations, and a foundational-model improvement restriction. Those restrictions mechanically fail MSTR primary rights admission.
